overview: President Javier Milei has brought inflation down and opened Argentina to more investment, fueling a boom in energy and other export industries while small businesses and manufacturing struggle. The Trump administration is escalating lawsuits, raids, and arrests with just nine days until the midterms. Washington lawmakers and White House advisers view the current crop of AI leaders as a monumental political liability. In local news, a car drove into the Muni tunnel at the Embarcadero on Saturday afternoon, shutting down the Market Street subway for the night. Meanwhile, North Shore residents are bringing heavy machinery to Paukauila Stream to clear debris and mangroves ahead of the next major storm, and the University of Hawaii football team routed the Huskies 56-21 on the road.

items.title: Inside The Two Argentinas Under Javier Milei
items.summary: President Javier Milei has brought inflation down and fueled an energy export boom, though manufacturing, retail, and small businesses continue to struggle.

items.title: Trump's DOJ barrels into midterms with lawsuits, raids and arrests
items.summary: The Trump administration is escalating its assault on DOJ guardrails of independence and restraint with lawsuits, raids, and arrests just nine days before midterms.

items.title: Washington's message to AI execs: please shut up
items.summary: Lawmakers and White House advisers state that the current crop of AI leaders is becoming a monumental political liability for Washington.

items.title: Car drives into Muni tunnel, shutting down Market St. subway for night
items.summary: A car drove into the Muni tunnel at the Embarcadero on Saturday afternoon, disrupting service and shutting down the Market Street subway for the night.

items.title: ‘Bows rout Huskies 56-21 on the road
items.summary: The University of Hawaii football team routed the Huskies 56-21 on the road in DeKalb, Illinois.

items.title: Residents on Oahu’s North Shore take on dredging as lawsuits seek accountability
items.summary: Oahu North Shore residents are spending the weekend bringing heavy machinery to Paukauila Stream to cut back mangroves and clear debris.

items.title: Local advocate Cheryl Dickerson dies at 86
items.summary: Cheryl Lynn Dickerson, a well-known Waikiki volunteer, hostess, and community advocate, has died at the age of 86.
